<!-- verdify-paused-handoff-20261012:964 -->
Jason's shutdown handoff: **implementation and delivery PAUSED; do not auto-resume.**

**Current state:** CLOSED accepted bounded full promotion/Lab/band recovery slice. Production remains Synced/Healthy b5 at capture. This closure is not combined37fd delivery or a replacement for a fresh writer census.

**Blockers:** Jason explicitly paused all implementation/delivery. No new work or wider acceptance is implied by this historical closure.

**Next step on explicit resume:** Retain closure and original receipts. On explicit resume, use this bounded acceptance only within its stated source/time/scope; refresh runtime-sensitive facts before relying on them.

**Acceptance retained:**
- [x] Exact intended revision/render and running image specifications agree; full operation Succeeded and Argo Synced/Healthy; required migrations/bootstrap/readiness hooks have explicit results.
- [x] Replacement Lab pods become ready using supported storage placement; existing public tree and recovery data survive. At least three natural publisher runs complete on the declared cadence with current fresh_until and served/success generation agreement.
- [x] Band-refresh Jobs schedule and complete at natural cadence, with fresh downstream rows and no hidden backlog/deadline failure.
- [x] Singleton writer, fresh telemetry and authenticated API/MCP behavior remain proven. Any socket-monitor UNKNOWN remains unaccepted until a complete observable census succeeds.
- [x] Exact prior pins/specs/cache/PVC recovery coordinates and owner decisions are published; no DB/PVC pruning or unrelated estate mutation.
